title: The seating chart. Part 4
note: Silent. Frame 1 fully composed: ONE strip (hook), two large faces, his phone lit mid-swipe, big tent card TABLE 2 / moved for family photos with arrow at her seat, aunt with clipboard small behind. He flips the phone at ~1.8 and double-takes at the card. Take 1 (take me with you) fails on him: he drags his chair to table 2 and ends up squeezed into the family photo, flash. Lazy Susan back, take 2 (i'll swap our cards.): tiptoe swap of COUSIN RAJ's card with his own, Raj ends up happy at table 9, he sits beside her, the aunt double-takes and shrugs, she writes (smooth.). Cliff: DJ booth LAST SONG, she slides (dance?), he freezes. Vote A (I CAN'T. TEACH ME?) / B (I'LL WATCH YOUR BAG.). No NoSwipe mention.

hooks.a: the stranger beside me at this wedding just got moved away.
hooks.b: they moved the girl I like to table 2. I had a plan.
